paper.title: Sukumar & Srivastava (2021 preprint), Exact imposition of boundary conditions with distance functions in physics-informed deep neural networks
paper.scope: Independent unit-disk Poisson/Dirichlet teaching adaptation using circular ADF equation7 and a known nonzero lift;not original multidomain,R-function assembly,Neumann,Robin,biharmonic or4D benchmarks. Raw exact-distance control is intentionally non-C1 at centre and cannot define a classical strong residual there.
